blocks.text: When to Use: Graphs are used when you need to represent a set of objects (nodes) and the connections (edges) between them. Graphs are particularly useful in problems involving networks, such as:

items: Social Networks: Representing users and their connections (friends, followers).
Pathfinding Algorithms: Like finding the shortest path in maps or game development.
Dependency Resolution: Such as determining the build order of software projects with interdependent components.
